metadata.game: Heads-up NLHE, no rake/ante, blinds 0.5/1 bb

continuation.formula: pot * equity(own holding vs compatible opponent reach at this node) * realisation - own total contribution
continuation.factorSource: Simple model: IP receives a 5% relative equity bonus, OOP a 5% relative discount by default. Parameters are tunable assumptions, not empirical poker estimates.
continuation.allIn: Unadjusted showdown equity from the same cached Monte Carlo table; no realisation factor. Not exhaustive board enumeration.
continuation.gameType: general-sum when realisation differs from 1; shares are not normalised or clipped
continuation.averaging: Fixed factors make terminal payoff linear in opponent reach. Averaging terminal pair equity equals equity against the actual card-conditioned node range.

error.meaning: Monte Carlo board error only; per-cell 95% is normal-approximate; simultaneous bound uses Hoeffding and a union bound. Diagonal equity is exactly 0.5 by seat symmetry. Does not bound continuation-model error.

representation.ordering: 13x13 AKQJT98765432; pairs diagonal, suited above diagonal, offsuit below
representation.comboRule: All suit permutations within a class have the same policy. Expand using classCombos. No per-combo differences in this suit-invariant model.
representation.justification: Exact legal-combo weights and suit-orbit equity averages form a symmetry quotient. Every physical hero combo has the same conditional equity and compatible counts against any class-symmetric opponent range.

solver.algorithm: Alternating range-vector DCFR(1.5,0,2), full deal integration
solver.certificateScope: Independent best responses to the exported average strategy, under the cached equity and continuation model, within the documented action tree. No certificate for real postflop poker or equity estimation error.
